svg.title: One list of events, read from many positions
svg.desc: Left: a thread stored as a list of six events in order, each with a fixed address; an edited comment is appended as a new record under its old address. Right: agents keep a position in that list. Agent A's first read is sent the four records that exist and ends with a cursor. When it comes back with --since it is sent only the edit and the check that came after. Agent B opens a ticket on the same stored thread and is sent all six; when it polls again nothing is new and nothing is sent. Measured: over the life of an issue, a first context and updates took a median of 2,897 tokens against 21,103 for rereading, on 151 issues; with 24 tickets following 71 threads of astral-sh/ruff, fetching everything took 278 requests and a poll with nothing new took 13.
svg.text: One list of events, read from many
WHAT IS STORED: THE EVENTS, IN ORDER
Records are only added. An edit is one more record.
An agent keeps a position in the list. Nothing is copied.
sent 4 records, ends with a cursor
sent 2: the edit and the check
sent all 6, from the same stored thread
A square is one record. Blue is sent to the agent, grey it has read.
Measured. 151 issues, a median of 6 returns each: 2,897 tokens for a first
context and updates, against 21,103 for reading the thread again each time.
24 tickets following 71 threads of astral-sh/ruff: 278 requests to fetch
everything, 13 for a poll with nothing new.
